input.business_intent: Which is the best selling product?

args.sql_query:
-- Query 1: Top selling products by quantity and revenue
SELECT 
    fk_product_name AS product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) AS avg_price_per_unit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_quantity_sold) DESC) AS rank_by_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC) AS rank_by_revenue
FROM best_selling_products
GROUP BY fk_product_name, category
ORDER BY SUM(total_quantity_sold) DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Query 2: Top 15 products by revenue (comprehensive ranking)
SELECT 
    fk_product_name AS product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM best_selling_products
GROUP BY fk_product_name, category
ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC
LIMIT 15;

-- Query 3: Top 5 products market share analysis
SELECT 
    fk_product_name AS product_name,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_revenue) / (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) FROM best_selling_products), 2) AS revenue_percentage
FROM best_selling_products
GROUP BY fk_product_name
ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Query 4: Product distribution by category
SELECT 
    category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fk_product_name) AS product_count,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_revenue) / (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) FROM best_selling_products), 2) AS revenue_percentage
FROM best_selling_products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC;
